content.short: Proof of Play RNG is a verifiable on-chain random number generation service for smart contracts.
content.description: Proof of Play RNG generates random numbers on-chain for games and applications that need verifiable draws. Contracts request a number and receive it through a callback, with support for multiple distinct numbers inside the same block window and manual retries authorised by EIP-712 signatures. The vRNG contracts are deployed on HyperEVM alongside ApeChain, Abstract, Avalanche, Base and BNB Chain, with addresses published per network. A marketplace API covers the commercial side for studios integrating it.
content.meta: Verifiable randomness for contracts, where block data alone cannot be trusted.
